categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen AV-Display Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of liquid crystal display (LCD) and touch products. Its main product lines include monochrome LCD displays, monochrome LCD modules, color LCD modules, and capacitive touch screens, serving industrial control and automation, IoT and smart living, healthcare, and automotive electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as ARM control boards, industrial computers, embedded control systems, electronic paper materials and modules, specialized optical touch display modules, high-performance PMVA-LCD, fast-response liquid crystal light valves, and automotive anti-glare liquid crystal light valves. Production involves processes like COG/FOG bonding, optical lamination, SMT, glass cutting, plasma cleaning, etching, and encapsulation, with some simple production steps outsourced under strict quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include ABB, Omron, HP, Siemens, GE, Schneider, BYD, Samsung, Panasonic, and others, spanning industrial automation, smart home appliances, medical devices, and automotive manufacturers. The company’s products are integrated into end products such as industrial controllers, smart appliances, medical instruments, and automotive dashboards, serving both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with subsidiaries in Shenzhen, Beijing, Ganzhou, Hong Kong, and Thailand. Its products are exported to North America (USA, Canada), Europe (Germany, UK, France, Belgium, Switzerland, Netherlands, Turkey), Asia (Japan, South Korea), and Taiwan, reflecting a broad international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen AV-Display operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of LCD and touch display modules. It procures raw materials such as TFT screens, chips, electronic components, backlight materials, ITO glass, and polarizers, and supplies customized display solutions to downstream product manufacturers and technical service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation and R&D, investing heavily in emerging technologies like electronic paper displays, automotive curved surface lamination, high-contrast integrated touch-display modules, smart home energy control modules, UV-blocking touch display modules, and privacy-protecting liquid crystal light valve technology. It aims to expand product diversity, enhance core competitiveness, and develop new applications aligned with market trends and national policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized LCD and touch display products to terminal product manufacturers and technical service providers. The company’s income derives from the difference between product sales revenue and associated costs, with sales conducted both domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading high-tech enterprise in the LCD and touch display industry in China, with strong R&D capabilities and a comprehensive product portfolio. It competes with other domestic and international display manufacturers by offering integrated touch-display solutions and customized products, maintaining certifications and quality standards to serve high-end clients.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.085 billion, a 9.02% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 90.6 million, a 25.91% decrease due to order structure changes and increased R&D investment. Total assets were about RMB 1.65 billion, with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen AV-Display offers highly customized, integrated touch and display solutions combining display modules and capacitive touch screens, reducing customers’ supply chain complexity and costs. Its strong R&D foundation, extensive patent portfolio, and quality management certifications enable it to deliver reliable, innovative products tailored to diverse industrial, automotive, healthcare, and smart living applications, thereby enhancing customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
